prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce a replacement production game animation sprite sheet, based strictly on the attached reference creature. The image must be a TALL RECTANGLE with 1:2 width:height, EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 8 equal rows of SQUARE cells. 32 different hand-drawn sprite poses. Transparent background, no text, labels, borders or checkerboard. Same reference identity, colors and rough low-resolution pixel-art style, facing the same direction as reference. Draw each sprite as coarse native 32x32 pixel art enlarged with crisp square pixel clusters. No antialiasing, glow, gradients, texture noise, painterly lighting or shadows.

CRITICAL SIZE CONTRACT: same scale in ALL cells. The resting creature fills about 24 pixels wide and 21 pixels tall inside its notional 32x32 cell. The feet rest at y30, body centered at x16. Every pose, including attack, is AT MOST 28 pixels wide and 29 pixels tall. An attack can be no more than 1.10 times the resting creature width. Keep the same large BODY MASS in every row. Do not extend a limb, tongue, projectile, silk fan or flame trail beyond this compact silhouette envelope. No separated projectiles. No effects needing extra margin. No extra transparent canvas borders: cell1 starts in the top-left quarter-column and last column ends at right edge; each cell sprite centered within its own equal cell. Each pose changes anatomy, not whole-body translation. Every cell contains the same boss at the same camera zoom. Four distinct successive drawings per row; rows top to bottom idle, walk, windup, attack, recovery, vulnerable, hurt, death.

Palette is exact dark teal #10171c #1d2b34 #2b4645, moss #3d5146 #536448, bark #605047 #82725b, cream #b5b190 #d7d4b1, subdued plum #493650 #847088, frost-grey #547580 #98b0b0. Amber #ab7833 #d4a64e ONLY row3 telegraph; cyan #4b8e92 #77bbb9 ONLY row6 vulnerable. All other rows muted. The background is truly alpha-transparent, no translucent dark backdrop.

Subject: Wick Hermit, exact reference tall pale-cream candle-shell over dark twig legs, three short black wicks at top, drippy wax face ridge, muted-plum joints. Maintain the original tall candle mass. Resting creature near24pixels wide and23pixels high. Large candle cap occupies upper-half body, dark twig legs occupy lower-half. Four wicks/legs clearly articulated, no human face. Row1: wick tips curl, wax cheek sags, candle cap lifts in a breath, opposite wax cheek sags. Row2: four short alternating twig-leg steps under the cap, knees lift then tuck, shell sways but does not slide around cell. Row3: legs brace, cap lifts, three SMALL amber flames lick straight UP between wicks, flames curl inward. Row4: candle hat hinges UP opening dark interior, wax maw opens DOWN inside leg silhouette, ivory flame churns INSIDE the open maw, cap snaps closed. Do NOT draw a projectile, tongue or flame extending sideways. Row5: cap droops, wax teeth stretch down, knees recover, wicks stand. Row6: cap opens above body to expose cyan hollow interior in four pulsing poses, legs trembling under same broad cap. Row7: wick and front knee buckle, shell dents inward, opposite knee catches, wax shakes. Row8: wicks wilt, candle cap sinks vertically around folded legs, wax ridge settles, compact collapsed wax mound with bent wicks; never wider than idle.
